entries.name: GW-8 Engine Captain - Template
entries.text:
This is an exciting opportunity to serve as an Engine Captain and be a part of the future of wildland fire management with the U.S. Wildland Fire Service in the Northern Rockies Geographic Area. This role offers the chance to lead and influence a dynamic fire program during a period of transformation, while working alongside an exceptional and dedicated group of fire professionals. Engine Captains play a key leadership role in fostering and strengthening their engine crew members, working closely with federal, state, tribal, and local partners to deliver operational excellence across shared landscapes.

The Northern Rockies Geographic Area offer an exceptional quality of life with strong community connections, a culture of collaboration, and unparalleled landscapes, along with abundant outdoor recreational opportunities — such as hiking, hunting, fishing, and skiing — and close proximity and access to expansive public lands.
